content:
Starting with iOS 26.4, Apple has supported conversational apps on CarPlay.

This category includes AI chatbot apps. Siri AI will join CarPlay starting from iOS 27. That iPhone software update is currently in beta and will be officially released in September.

Meanwhile, the fourth third-party AI chatbot—Meta AI—has officially added support for Apple CarPlay.

The Meta AI iPhone app is now available on Apple CarPlay—but there's a catch

The latest version of the Meta AI iPhone app now supports CarPlay.

The Meta AI app joins three other third-party chatbot apps that already support CarPlay: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Grok.

However, Meta AI's support on CarPlay appears to still be in limited beta for the time being.

Although the iPhone app shows up in CarPlay, launching it may currently display a "not supported" message.

Personally, when I launch the app in CarPlay, it shows "Your account does not currently support the Meta AI experience."

I tried using a paid Meta AI account to see if CarPlay support is limited to paid accounts only. However, the message in the Meta AI CarPlay app did not change. Actual experience may vary.

Regardless, it's great to see a fourth mainstream chatbot app on CarPlay before Siri AI officially rolls out to everyone.

That's the core strength of CarPlay: seamlessly integrating your existing iPhone apps with your car. Built-in infotainment systems simply cannot offer such a rich selection.

Earlier this month, Meta AI also landed on Mac. The desktop version is far more powerful than the iPhone and iPad versions.
